description: Evolve a 4-bar linkage mechanism to trace a figure-8 shape. The linkage can be 3D printed and demonstrated physically.

solution_format.description: Solution files must ONLY define 6 numeric variables - nothing else!
solution_format.CRITICAL: Do NOT create classes, functions, or imports. Just 6 variable assignments.

optimization_strategies.name: link_length_tuning
optimization_strategies.description: Adjust individual link lengths (L1, L2, L3, L4)
optimization_strategies.hint: Small changes to link lengths dramatically affect the coupler curve shape

optimization_strategies.name: tracer_position
optimization_strategies.description: Move the tracer point position (Px, Py) on the coupler
optimization_strategies.hint: The tracer point location has huge impact on the curve - try different offsets

optimization_strategies.name: grashof_optimization
optimization_strategies.description: Adjust links to satisfy Grashof condition for full rotation
optimization_strategies.hint: For full rotation: shortest + longest <= sum of other two

optimization_strategies.name: proportional_scaling
optimization_strategies.description: Scale link lengths while adjusting ratios
optimization_strategies.hint: The shape depends on ratios between links, not absolute sizes

constraints: CRITICAL: Solution must ONLY contain 6 variable assignments: L1, L2, L3, L4, Px, Py
NO imports, NO classes, NO functions - just the 6 numbers
All link lengths (L1, L2, L3, L4) must be positive floats
Px can be any float (position along coupler)
Py can be any float (perpendicular offset)
Example valid solution: L1=4.0, L2=1.0, L3=3.0, L4=2.5, Px=1.5, Py=0.8

linkage_physics.L1: Ground link - distance between the two fixed pivot points
linkage_physics.L2: Crank - the input link that rotates (typically shortest for full rotation)
linkage_physics.L3: Coupler - connects crank tip to follower tip
linkage_physics.L4: Follower - the output rocker pivoting at the second fixed point
linkage_physics.Px: Tracer X - distance along coupler from crank-coupler joint
linkage_physics.Py: Tracer Y - perpendicular offset from coupler line
linkage_physics.grashof: For full rotation: shortest + longest <= sum of other two links
